text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm lovestruck. ♪
I want to hold you
close. ♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
This is a song by my friend's favorite
idol. She
invited me out to sing it with
her at karaoke,
hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
The lyrics are a little embarrassing, but
they're
easier to say when they're put to
a melody. Music
is strange like that, isn't
it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm lovestruck. ♪
I only have eyes for
you. ♪
